task: hk/byte-extract: Honeykrisp dynamic shift-then-mask byte extraction miscompile
machine: jwm1-linux, Apple M1 (G13G B1), Honeykrisp; stock driver Mesa 26.1.7, fixed driver Mesa 26.3.0-devel built from this branch
pass: agx_nir_fuse_algebraic_late (fuse_ubfe rules in agx_nir_algebraic.py), run before agx_nir_lower_algebraic_late/lower_sm5_shift
root_cause: iand(ushr(a, b), (1<<bits)-1) was fused into ubitfield_extract(a, b, bits) for any b. NIR ushr masks its count to 5 bits and the main nir_opt_algebraic has already stripped explicit masks on that basis (ushr(a, iand(b,31)) -> ushr(a,b); ushr(a, ishl(iand(b,3),3)) -> ushr(a, ishl(b,3))). ubitfield_extract/bfeil does not wrap: hardware returns 0 for offsets >= 32 (measured: any count with a bit above bit 4 set). lower_sm5_shift masks surviving shifts but runs after the fusion.
fix: Fuse directly only for constant counts < 32 ('#b(is_ult_32)'); for non-constant counts fuse with an explicit iand(b, 31) on the offset.

ir_diff_excerpt.before_nir:
%11 = imadshl_agx 0, 1, %3, 3   ; g << 3 (the & 3 already stripped by nir_opt_algebraic)
%12 = ubitfield_extract 0x10001, %11, 8
ir_diff_excerpt.before_asm:
iadd $r2, 0, r1.sx, lsl 3
bfeil r2, 0, u8, r2, 8
ir_diff_excerpt.after_asm:
iadd $r2, 0, r1.sx, lsl 3
and $r2, r2, 31
bfeil r2, 0, u8, r2, 8

stock_results.note: mismatch counts are out of 1024 lanes; loop_wordbase and the raw/unmasked shifts pass because lower_sm5_shift masks plain shifts and the word_base loop never forms the fused pattern

suites.regressions: none; the suites are green on both because mlx-omarchy still carries its shader workarounds (not removed here, per task)

deviations: Task listed candidates in agx_optimizer/8-bit lowering/subgroups/store coalescing; the defect is entirely in the NIR-level fuse rule, none of those were touched.
loop_wordbase (gather_qmm word_base induction) did not reproduce on stock: its comment attributes the original miscompile to Lavapipe 22.3, not Honeykrisp.

cast.comp bool-word-load-in-loop and elementwise Payne-Hanek were not separately reproduced; both are shift-then-mask consumers and are covered by the same fused pattern, but no dedicated variant was written.
Compiler unit test not added: src/asahi/compiler/test covers AGX IR passes only, not the generated NIR algebraic passes.
